newsitem.title: NORWAY: SAS JULY PASSENGER TRAFFIC ROSE 5.1 YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: SAS JULY PASSENGER TRAFFIC ROSE 5.1 YR/YR.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) said on Friday passenger traffic in July rose 5.1 percent compared with the same year ago period.

SAS said that with production capacity in the month almost unchanged at minus 0.3 percent measured in available seat kilometres (ASK), the passenger load factor increased by 3.6 points to 70.7 percent.
The accumulated passenger traffic for the period of January to July was 4.1 percent higher than the corresponding 1996 period, it said in a statement to the Oslo bourse.
